source: Carl Bezold, Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige (Munich, 1905), ch. 95 — public domain. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: The Council of the Fathers declares the king of Ethiopia the most glorious of kings, seed of Shem and king of Zion; the Christ is recalled, the Jews who crucified him are condemned and Ethiopia, which believed, is loved; Gregory then names Mary as the likeness of heavenly Zion, and the Council turns to the Law to begin the prophecies of Christ, starting from Genesis 1.

sentences.n: Chapter heading, obscure (?). ኀበ is a preposition 'at, to, with' but, as at the head of a title, 'how' (?); ኀብሩ is either the verb 'they gathered/agreed' (3mp perfect) or a noun ኅብር 'union' + -ሁ 'his' (?); ክብሩ is ክብር 'glory' + -ሁ 'his', with the owner named after it by ለ- (the anticipating pattern, as ክብራ ... ለጽዮን in unit 11); ፺፭ is the numeral 95; ለንጉሠ is ለ- + ንጉሥ in the construct state before ኢትዮጵያ ('of the king of Ethiopia'). ኀብሩ is plural beside the singular ክብሩ, which favours the noun ኅብር. The sense 'how the glory of the king of Ethiopia is brought together' is a guess (?); 'with Zion' is not in the Geʿez.

sentences.i: Concerning the glory of kings, we have learned and inquired that the king of Ethiopia is glorious: he is king of Zion, and he too is a firstborn (?) of the seed of Shem; his dwelling also is in Zion of God, and there he breaks the might of all his enemies and haters.
sentences.n: ወበእንተሰ is ወ- 'and' + በእንተ 'concerning' + emphatic -ሰ; ክብረ ነገሥት is a construct chain, 'glory of kings' (the book's title phrase). ከመ ይከብር is 'that he is glorious' (3ms imperfect of ከብረ). ንጉሠ ጽዮን is 'king of Zion' (construct). ወበኵርኒ is uncertain (?): perhaps ወ- + በኵር 'firstborn' + enclitic -ኒ 'also', 'and he too is a firstborn'. ዘርአ ሴም 'seed of Shem' (Shem as ancestor of the Semitic peoples, Genesis 10:21-31); ማኅደሩሂ is ማኅደር 'dwelling' + -ሁ 'his' + -ሂ 'too'. ኀይለ is construct 'might of'; ፀሩ and ጸላእቱ are 'his enemies' and 'his haters' (ፀር collective + -ሁ; ጸላኢ plural ጸላእት + -ሁ).

sentences.l: And-after-him king-of Rome anointed-his of-God for-sake-of wood-of cross, and-kingdom-of Israel-indeed from-when she-was-born pearl(?) from-them, and-from-pearl(?) again was-born sun-of righteousness being-hidden in-flesh her, and-if-indeed not he-was-hidden in-flesh-of man, if not he-appeared to-eyes-of mortal;
sentences.i: After him (comes) the king of Rome, God's anointed, on account of the wood of the cross; and as for the kingdom of Israel, from the time that a pearl (?) was born from them, and from that pearl again was born the Sun of Righteousness, veiled in her flesh. And had he not been veiled in human flesh, he would not have appeared to mortal eyes (?);
sentences.n: A loose, elliptical sentence. ንጉሠ ሮም is construct, 'king of Rome', and መሲሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his anointed of God' (the emperor as God's anointed; the reason given is the cross, perhaps Constantine's (?): ዕፀ መስቀል 'wood of the cross', construct). ወመንግሥተ እስራኤልሰ is 'and as for the kingdom of Israel' (construct + emphatic -ሰ). ባሕርይ: the house reading is 'pearl' (the word also means 'nature'; either fits, (?)); the feminine verb ተወልደት 'she was born' agrees with it, and 'pearl' as a title of Mary is a guess (?); then masculine ተወልደ for the Son, from 'the pearl' again. ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'Sun of Righteousness' is Malachi 4:2. ተሰዊሮ 'being hidden/veiled' (converb of ተሰወረ, the incarnation); ዚአሃ 'her'. ወእመሰ ... እመ ኢ- 'and if ... if not': two ኢ- clauses in a row, read together as one condition, 'had he not been veiled, he would not have appeared' (?); the second እመ may only repeat the first. The next unit says what he did instead. No verb stands in the first clause of the unit; 'comes' is supplied.

sentences.n: Each object takes -ሆሙ 'their' with a linking -ኒ- after the plural -ን (as in ቅዱሳኒሁ 'his holy ones'), not 'also' (?) (ሙታኒሆሙ 'their dead', ድዉያኒሆሙ 'their sick', ዕዉራኒሆሙ 'their blind', ጽሙማኒሆሙ 'their deaf'). አዕይንተ and እዝነ are construct before the next word ('eyes of', 'ear of'). Echoes Isaiah 35:5-6 and Matthew 11:5. እለ ለምጽ 'those (of) leprosy'; አጽገበ 'he satisfied' (causative); ዘተጽሕፈ ወዘኢተጽሕፈ 'what was written and what was not written' (ዘ- relative).

sentences.i: As John the evangelist, son of Zebedee, said: if everything Jesus did were written down, the world could not at all hold (?) the books that would be written.
sentences.n: Allusion to John 21:25 (given as a paraphrase, not a quotation). በከመ ይቤ 'according as he said'; ወልደ ዘብዴዎስ 'son of Zebedee' (ዘ- as genitive marker). ሶበሰ ... እመ ኢ- 'if ... would not' is a contrary-to-fact condition. The wordspace in መጻሕፍ ፡ ቲሁ splits one word, መጻሕፍቲሁ 'its books', and ዘእምተጽሕፈ is read as 'that would be written' (?); ኢያግመሮ 'would not contain it' (?): read as a verb of holding from the Gospel parallel, but the root looks like አግመረ 'complete, bring to an end' (Dillmann, from memory), so 'could not finish (writing) them' is possible; ጥቀ 'very, exceedingly' strengthens the negative.

sentences.i: When the children of Israel, the wrongdoers, saw all this, they took him for a man, and they envied him because of what they saw and heard; they hanged him on the wood of the cross and killed him;
sentences.n: ወዘንተ ኵሎ 'and this, all' (accusative). ደቂቀ is construct plural 'sons of' (ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel'); ዐላዊያን 'wrongdoers, unjust ones' (plural). አምሰልዎ ከመ ሰብእ 'they likened him to a man', that is, they regarded him as an ordinary man. ወቀንኡ 'and they were jealous' (ቀንአ). ሰቀልዎ ... ወቀተልዎ: perfects with the suffix -ዎ 'him'. The Council speaks against the Jews here and again in units 8 and 10.

sentences.i: On the third day he rose from the dead and ascended into the heavens in glory, upon the throne of divinity; and he was given by the Father a kingdom that does not end, for ever and ever, over the spiritual and the earthly and over all creation, so that every tongue should bow to his name and every knee worship, and he should judge the living and the dead and repay each one according to his deeds.
sentences.n: ተንሥአ እሙታን 'he rose from the dead' (እም- 'from'); በሣልስት ዕለት 'on the third day'. መንበረ መለኮት 'throne of divinity' (construct). ተወፈየ is passive 'was given' (a gift), with መንግሥተ 'kingdom' as the thing given; ዘኢየኀልቅ 'which does not end'; ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for ever' (lit. 'to the world of the world'). መንፈሳዊያን ወመሬታዊያን 'spirit-beings and earthly beings'. Echoes Philippians 2:10-11 (every knee, every tongue) and Romans 2:6 (repay each according to deeds); ይግነይ 'should bow, serve' and ይስግድ 'should worship' are jussives after ከመ; ወይኴንን is ኰነነ 'judge' (not 'rule'), and ወይፈድዮ has -ኦ 'him', doubled by ለኵሉ 'to all' ('repay everyone'). This unit is long (38 words) but one sense-unit.

sentences.i: And God loved the people of Ethiopia, because before they knew his law they overthrew their idols; but those to whom the law of God was given made idols and worshipped gods whom God hates.
sentences.n: አፍቀሮሙ ለሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ 'he loved them, the people of Ethiopia' (the pronoun -ሙ doubles the ለ- object; ሕዝበ construct). እስመ ዘእንበለ ያእምሩ 'for before they knew' (ዘእንበለ 'without, before' + jussive). ሕጎ 'his law' (accusative, ሕግ + -ሁ). ሠረዉ 'they uprooted' (ሠረወ; the passive ተሠረዉ is in unit 10). ወእለሰ ተውህቦሙ 'and as for those to whom was given'; ሰገዲ read as the 3mp perfect ሰገዱ 'they bowed down' (the house reading; a noun 'worship' is the alternative (?)); ዘይጸልእ እግዚኣብሔር 'whom God hates'. Contrasts Ethiopia with Israel (the golden calf, Exodus 32, is presumably in mind (?)).

sentences.i: And in the last days, when he was born to redeem Adam, he did signs and wonders before them, and they did not believe in him, neither in his preaching nor in the preaching of his fathers; but the people of Ethiopia believed through one faithful disciple, and for this reason God loved the people of Ethiopia exceedingly.
sentences.n: በደኃሪ 'in the last (time)'. ከመ ይቤዝዎ ለአዳም 'that he might redeem Adam' (ይቤዝዎ is the 3ms subjunctive with the object suffix -ዎ, doubled by ለአዳም). ኢአምኑ ቦቱ 'they did not believe in him'; ኢበስብከቱ ወኢበስብከተ አበዊሁ 'neither in his preaching nor in the preaching of his fathers' (the prophets, perhaps (?)). በ፩ ረድእ መሀይምን 'in/through one faithful disciple'; መሀይምን 'faithful, believer' is a singular participle (the -ን is the last root letter of ሀይመነ, from the root of አምነ, not a plural ending), agreeing with ረድእ. The text does not name him; the reader may think of Philip and the Ethiopian official (Acts 8) (?). ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ፨ marks the speech's end.

sentences.i: For the dwelling of God was there, heavenly Zion, the ark of his law and the ark of his covenant, which he made (into) a mercy (?), out of mercy toward the children of men: for the cold seasons (?) and for the rains, for plants and for fruits, for the nations and for the lands (?), for kings and for rulers, for people and for cattle, for birds and for wild animals.
sentences.n: ማኅደሩ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the dwelling of God' (ለ- repeats the owner). ጽዮን ሰማያዊት 'heavenly Zion' is the Ark itself (ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark of his law', ታቦተ ኪዳኑ 'ark of his covenant', both construct; ኪዳን 'covenant'). እንተ ረሰያ ለምሥሃል 'which he made her (into) a mercy' (?): ለምሥሃል 'for mercy', sense uncertain; the mercy seat (Exodus 25:17-22) may be meant, but that is not in the word. ምሕረተ ውሉደ ሰብእ 'mercy of the sons of man' (two constructs). Then a series of pairs, each ለ- 'for': ክራማት (?) read 'winters, cold or rainy seasons', ዝናማት 'rains', አትክልት 'plants', ፍረያት 'fruits', አሕዛብ 'nations', በሓውርት (?) uncertain, perhaps 'lands, wildernesses', ነገሥት, መኳንንት 'rulers', ሰብእ, እንስሳ 'cattle, domestic animals', አዕዋፍ 'birds', አራዊት 'wild animals'. Zion's care covers the whole world.

sentences.i: Gregory the bishop, the wonder-worker, answered and said to them: In truth salvation was given to us, to all of us, the Christian people who believed in her, our lady Mary, the likeness of heavenly Zion;
sentences.n: ጎርጎርዮስ ጳጳስ ገባሬ መንክር 'Gregory the bishop, worker of wonder' (ገባሬ construct); the epithet is as in the text, and the text itself does not say which Gregory (?). ተውህበት is feminine passive 'was given' (the subject መድኀኒት 'salvation' is feminine). ለኵልነ 'to all of us'; ሕዝበ ከርስቲያን 'the Christian people' (construct). ለእለ አመነ ባቲ 'to those who believed in her'. ለእግዝእትነ ማርያም 'our lady Mary' (the ለ- names the owner after the suffix of ባቲ, the anticipating pattern; it is not 'in'). አምሳሊሃ ለጽዮን 'her likeness, of Zion': Mary is the Ark's type; the Ark/Zion/Mary equation is central to the book.

sentences.n: Genesis 1:1. በቀዳሚ 'in the beginning'; ሰማየ ወምድረ accusative, 'heaven and earth'. ወህልው እምትካት is uncertain (?): 'and existing from of old', with እምትካት read as 'from the beginning', but the subject could instead be 'it (the heavens and earth) existed from the beginning'.

sentences.l: And-earth-indeed not-was prepared but mixed-ones darkness and-wind and-water and-mist and-soil all-them mixed-ones, and-spirit-of God hovers above water;
sentences.i: And the earth was not made ready, but was confused: darkness and wind and water and mist and soil, all of them mixed together; and the Spirit of God hovered over the water;
sentences.n: Genesis 1:2 expanded: 'without form and void' is rendered ኢኮነት ድሉተ 'was not prepared' and ድሙራን 'mixed together, confused' (plural; ድሙር). ጽልመት 'darkness', ነፋስ 'wind', ማይ 'water', ጊሜ 'mist, cloud', መሬት 'soil, earth'. መንፈሰ እግዚኣብሔር 'Spirit of God' (construct). ይጼልል 'overshadows, hovers' (a present-tense imperfect in a story); መልዕልተ ማይ 'above the water'.

sentences.i: As for this that he said, 'By the word of God the heavens and the earth were created, and the Spirit of God dwelt upon all creation', that is what it says. (The text ends with a row of ፨ signs.)
sentences.n: ዘንተሰ ዘይቤ 'as for this which he said' (accusative ዘንተ + -ሰ). በቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'by the word of God' (construct); ተፈጥሩ 'were created' (passive of ፈጠረ); ኀደረ 'dwelt', as in the previous unit. ብሂል 'saying, meaning' (noun of ብህለ 'say') closes the explanation, like 'that is'. The text ends with a row of ፨ marks.

glossary.ባሕርይ: ባሕርይ — pearl (noun) · also 'nature, essence' (ተወልደት ባሕርይ እምኔሆሙ 'a nature was born from them', ch. 95; the unit reads 'pearl' (?))
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ብዲተ: ብዲት — desolate, laid waste (?) (noun or adjective, accusative predicate; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ተመሰለ: ተመሰለ — he was likened, was made like (3ms perfect, passive-reflexive, m-s-l; with accusative ኪያነ 'like us')
glossary.ተርጒሞ: ተርጐመ — interpreting, translating (infinitive of ተርጐመ, quadriliteral, t-r-g-m; construct 'the interpreting of')
glossary.ተሰዊሮ: ተሰወረ — having been hidden, veiled (3ms gerund, Gt, s-w-r)
glossary.ተወልደት: ተወልደ — be born (3fs perfect, passive T stem)
glossary.ተውህበት: ተውህበ — she was given (3fs perfect, passive of ወሀበ; subject ታቦት) · subject መድኀኒት (ተውህበት ለነ መድኀኒት 'salvation was given to us', ch. 95)
glossary.ተውህቦሙ: ተውህበ — it was given them (3ms perfect passive + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ተገብረ: ገብረ — it was done, made (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — it was written (3ms perfect, passive of ጸሐፈ, ṣ-ḥ-f); also in the quotation 'it is written' (ተጽሕፈ በእንቲአየ)
glossary.ተፈጥሩ: ተፈጥረ — they were created (3m pl passive perfect, f-ṭ-r)
glossary.ቲሁ: መጽሐፍ — -ቲሁ, the ending of መጻሕፍቲሁ 'its books' (plural -ት + -ሁ '3ms its'; split from መጻሕፍ by the wordspace)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትንቢቶሙ: ትንቢት — their prophecy (noun + -ሙ '3mp their', anticipating ለነቢያት)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀብሩ: ኀብረ — they gathered, assembled (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-b-r) · they agreed, conspired (3mp perfect, here of a wicked agreement)
glossary.ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
glossary.ኀደረ: ኀደረ — he dwelt, abode (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-d-r)
glossary.ነበብከ: ነበበ — you have spoken, said (G 2ms perf.)
glossary.ነአኀዝኬ: አኀዘ — let us begin, take hold (1cp jussive, G, ʾ-ḫ-z + -ኬ 'then, now')
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
glossary.ንሄሉ: ሀለወ — we shall be, dwell (1cp imperfect, G, h-l-w; 'sit' of a throne)
glossary.ንንግር: ነገረ — let us tell (1cp jussive, G, n-g-r)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አልዐለ: አልዐለ — he exalted (3ms perfect, causative, ʿ-l-w; subject not named)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
glossary.አምሰልዎ: አምሰለ — they likened him, took him for (3mp perfect, causative, m-s-l + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.አምሳሊሃ: አምሳል — her likeness (noun + -ሃ '3fs her', anticipating the owner)
glossary.አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
glossary.አንሥአ: አንሥአ — he raised up, lifted (3ms perfect, causative a-stem)
glossary.አንጽሐ: አንጽሐ — he cleansed, purified (3ms perfect, causative, n-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
glossary.አዕይንተ: ዐይን — eyes (plural አዕይንት, accusative) · construct 'eyes of' (አዕይንተ ዕዉራኒሆሙ 'the eyes of their blind', ch. 95)
glossary.አጽገበ: አጽገበ — he satisfied, fed (3ms perfect, causative, ṣ-g-b)
glossary.አፍቀሮሙ: አፍቀረ — he loved them (3ms perfect, f-q-r + -ሙ '3mp them'; ለ- phrase doubles the object)
glossary.ኢበስብከቱ: ስብከት — not in his preaching (ኢ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ኢተርእየ: ተርእየ — he was not seen, did not appear (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, passive-reflexive ተ- stem, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ኢተሰወረ: ተሰወረ — he was not hidden, veiled (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, Gt passive of ሰወረ, s-w-r)
glossary.ኢትዮጵያሰ: ኢትዮጵያ — Ethiopia, as for Ethiopia (proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for', contrastive)
glossary.ኢኮነት: ኮነ — she was not (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢያግመሮ: አግመረ — to complete, finish; here perhaps 'hold, contain' (?) (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ '3ms it'; apodosis of a contrary-to-fact condition; 'hold' is read from the Gospel parallel, 'finish (writing)' is also possible) (?)
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
glossary.እሙታን: ሙት — from the dead (እም- 'from' + plural ሙታን)
glossary.እምርእሰ: ርእስ — from the head, beginning of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምትካት: ትካት — from the foundation, from of old (?) (እም- 'from' + ትካት 'establishment', cf. ዘትካት in ch. 30; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እምአመ: አመ — from the time that, since (እም- 'from' + አመ 'when', before a perfect verb)
glossary.እምኦሪተ: ኦሪት — from the Law of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — than all of them (እም- comparative 'than' + ኵሎሙ)
glossary.እምዘርአ: ዘርእ — from the seed of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — Israel indeed (proper name + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
glossary.ኦሪት: ኦሪት — the Torah, the Law (noun); ሕገ ኦሪት 'law of the Torah'
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከርስቲያን: ክርስቲያን — Christian (noun/adjective; spelled ከርስቲያን; ሕዝበ ከርስቲያን 'the Christian people')
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ክብራ: ክብር — her glory (noun + -ሃ 'her', anticipating ለጽዮን 'of Zion'; not a construct)
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ) · 'if it is' after እመ, the subject the unborn child (ወእመሂ ኮነት ወለተ 'and if it is a daughter') · 'was' of place (ማኅደሩ ለእግዚኣብሔር ኮነት ህየ 'God's dwelling was there', ch. 95)
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወህልው: ህልው — and existing, being (ወ- + adjective, from ሀለወ)
glossary.ወለመኳንንት: መኰንን — and for the governors, rulers (ወ- + ለ- + plural መኳንንት)
glossary.ወለበሓውርት: ብሔር — and for the lands, regions (ወ- + ለ- + plural በሓውርት of ብሔር; so read in ch. 54) (?)
glossary.ወለአራዊት: አርዌ — and for the wild beasts (ወ- + ለ- + plural አራዊት)
glossary.ወለእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and for cattle, domestic animals (ወ- + ለ- + collective noun)
glossary.ወለዝናማት: ዝናም — and for the rains (ወ- + ለ- + plural ዝናማት)
glossary.ወለፍረያት: ፍሬ — and for the fruits (ወ- + ለ- + plural ፍረያት)
glossary.ወላዕለ: ላዕለ — and against (ወ- + preposition ላዕለ 'upon, over, against')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — and the people of (ወ- + noun, accusative/construct 'people of')
glossary.ወመሬታዊያን: መሬታዊ — and earthly ones (ወ- + adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
glossary.ወመንክረ: መንክር — and marvel, wonder (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — and the kingdom (ወ- + noun; accusative)
glossary.ወመንግሥቶሙ: መንግሥት — and their kingdom (ወ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወመንፈሰ: መንፈስ — and spirit of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወሙታነ: ሙት — and dead ones (ወ- + noun, plural ሙታን, accusative)
glossary.ወማኅደሩሂ: ማኅደር — and his dwelling too (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወምድርሰ: ምድር — and the land indeed (ወ- + noun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — upright, fitting (adjective, masc. sg.; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወርኁባነ: ርኁብ — and hungry ones (ወ- + adjective used as noun, plural ርኁባን, accusative)
glossary.ወሰምዑ: ሰምዐ — and they heard (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወሰቀልዎ: ሰቀለ — and they hanged him, crucified him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወቀተልዎ: ቀተለ — and they killed him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, q-t-l + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወቀንኡ: ቀንአ — and they envied, were jealous (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, q-n-ʾ)
glossary.ወበትእዛዛቲሁ: ትእዛዝ — and in his commandments (ወ- + በ- + plural ትእዛዛት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወበአጽባዕተ: ጽብዕ — and with the fingers of (ወ- + በ- + plural አጽባዕት, construct)
glossary.ወበእንተሰ: በእንተ — and concerning indeed (ወ- + በእንተ + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበኵርኒ: በኵር — and also a firstborn (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'also'; predicate of ውእቱ) (?)
glossary.ወበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — and in the latter, last
glossary.ወብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — and many (ወ- + adjective, accusative, agreeing with ተኣምረ ወመንክረ)
glossary.ወተሠረዉ: ተሠርወ — and they were uprooted (ወ- + 3mp perfect, passive of ሠረወ, ś-r-w)
glossary.ወተርጐምከ: ተርጐመ — and you interpreted, translated (ወ- + 2ms perfect, quadriliteral, t-r-g-m)
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተወልደ: ተወልደ — and was born (ወ- + 3m sg passive perfect)
glossary.ወተወፈየ: ተወፈየ — and he was given, rewarded (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive of ወፈየ)
glossary.ወታቦተ: ታቦት — and the Ark (ወ- + noun, fem.; construct 'ark of')
glossary.ወኀልቁ: ኀልቀ — and they perished, came to an end (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḫ-l-q)
glossary.ወኅሩያኒሁ: ኅሩይ — and his chosen ones (ወ- + plural ኅሩያን + -ሁ '3ms his', with linking -ኒ-)
glossary.ወንለቡ: ለበወ — and let us understand (ወ- + 1cp jussive, G, l-b-w)
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንትፌሣሕ: ተፈሥሐ — and we shall rejoice (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, Gt, f-ś-ḥ)
glossary.ወአብርሀ: አብርሀ — and he/it shone (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative) · transitive 'and he made shine' (ወአብርሀ ገጾ ላዕሌሆሙ 'and he made his face shine upon them')
glossary.ወአንሶሰወ: አንሶሰወ — and it roamed, wandered about (ወ- + 3ms perfect, quadriliteral, n-s-s-w)
glossary.ወኢበስብከተ: ስብከት — and not in the preaching of (ወ- + ኢ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወኢአምኑ: አምነ — and they did not believe (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወእመሰ: እመ — and if (ወ- 'and' + conditional conjunction + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምባሕርይ: ባሕርይ — and from the pearl (?) (ወ- + እም- 'from' + noun; the word also means 'nature, essence') (?)
glossary.ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
glossary.ወከሠተ: ከሠተ — and he opened, uncovered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, k-ś-t)
glossary.ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወዕበያ: ዕበይ — and her greatness (ወ- + noun + -ሃ '3fs her', anticipating ለጽዮን)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘኢተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — and which was not written (ወ- + ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect passive of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ወይስግድ: ሰገደ — and he worships, bows down (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, s-g-d)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይትሌ: ተለወ — and he follows (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, t-l-w; perhaps part of ወይትለዐል, split) (?)
glossary.ወይትኀፈሩ: ኀፈረ — and they are ashamed (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, Gt, ḫ-f-r; coordinate with ይርአይዎ)
glossary.ወይትኴነኑ: ተኰነነ — and they are judged, condemned (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, passive of ኰነነ 'judge, condemn'; written with ኴ)
glossary.ወይከብር: ከብረ — and he is glorious, more glorious (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, k-b-r; with እም- 'than')
glossary.ወይኴንን: ኰነነ — and he judges (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ይኴንን)
glossary.ወይፈድዮ: ፈደየ — and he repays (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G ይፈድይ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወጊሜ: ጊሜ — and gloom, mist, darkness (ወ- + noun)
glossary.ወጠየቅነ: ጠየቀ — and we inquired, examined (ወ- + 1cp perfect, G, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ወጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — and exactly, accurately (ወ- + adjective, adverbial accusative)
glossary.ወጸላእቱ: ጸላኢ — and his haters, foes (ወ- + plural ጸላእት + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted -ቱ)
glossary.ወፈወሰ: ፈወሰ — and he healed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-w-s)
glossary.ውሉደ: ወልድ — sons, children (plural ውሉድ, accusative) · construct 'sons of' (ምሕረተ ውሉደ ሰብእ 'the mercy toward the sons of men', ch. 95)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዐል: ልዑል — high, exalted (?) (ʿ-l-w; the form ዐል may be a fragment of ይትለዐል 'is exalted', or 'exalted' standing after ወይትሌ) (?)
glossary.ዕዉራኒሆሙ: ዕዉር — their blind (plural ዕዉራን + -ሆሙ '3mp their', with linking -ኒ-)
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘብዴዎስ: ዘብዴዎስ — Zebedee (proper name; ወልደ ዘብዴዎስ 'son of Zebedee')
glossary.ዘተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which was written (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ዘንተሰ: ዝንቱ — as for this (accusative demonstrative ዘንተ + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ዘንዜንዎሙ: ዜነወ — which we tell them (ዘ- + 1cp imperfect, G, z-n-w + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ዘኢየኀልቅ: ኀልቀ — which does not end (ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-l-q)
glossary.ዘእምተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which would be written (?) (ዘ- relative + እም- + 3ms perfect passive; 'that [comes] from writing') (?)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ዝርዋነ: ዝርው — scattered, dispersed ones (adjective/participle of ዘርወ; plural accusative, predicate)
glossary.ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
glossary.የዐቢ: ዐበየ — he is great, greater (3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ያእምሩ: አእመረ — that they know, learn (3mp subjunctive, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ይርአይዎ: ርእየ — that they see him (3mp subjunctive, G, r-ʾ-y + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይሰብር: ሰበረ — he breaks, shatters (3ms imperfect, G, s-b-r)
glossary.ይቤዝዎ: ቤዘወ — that he redeem him (3ms subjunctive, G, b-z-w + -ዎ '3ms him'; ለአዳም names the one redeemed)
glossary.ይከብር: ከብረ — he is glorious, honoured (3ms imperfect, G, k-b-r; ከመ ይከብር 'that he is glorious')
glossary.ይግነይ: ገነየ — he bows, bends the knee (3ms subjunctive, G, g-n-y; after ከመ 'that')
glossary.ይጼልል: ጸለለ — he overshadows, hovers (3ms imperfect, G, ṣ-l-l)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድሉተ: ድሉት — prepared, ready (adjective, fem./accusative predicate; ኢኮነት ድሉተ 'was not made ready')
glossary.ድሙራን: ድሙር — mixed, confused, joined (adjective, plural ድሙራን)
glossary.ድዉያኒሆሙ: ድዉይ — their sick (plural ድዉያን + -ሆሙ '3mp their', with linking -ኒ-)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant') · they made (3mp perfect of ገብረ, G, g-b-r; ገብሩ አህጉረ 'they made cities')
glossary.ጣዖቶሙ: ጣዖት — their idols (noun, collective singular + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ጳጳስ: ጳጳስ — bishop (noun, singular; in apposition to ጎርጎርዮስ)
glossary.ጽሙማኒሆሙ: ጽሙም — their deaf (plural ጽሙማን + -ሆሙ '3mp their', with linking -ኒ-; 'deaf' or 'mute') (?)
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፈከርከ: ፈከረ — you explained, expounded (2ms perfect, G, f-k-r)
